title: Outbreak Line List: Unauthorized Edit Detected

fields.organization: Marston County Health Department — Epidemiology Division
fields.summary: During routine review of the outbreak response site, a draft line list was discovered with 5 new cases added since 08:50. One case is from a child in Lindell who has no known exposure to a confirmed case. The exposure window is listed as 2026-10-24 to 2026-11-01, dates that have not happened yet. No user activity log shows a login from my account. The edit was not made by any Epi team member. The version history shows the last edit was made from IP address 10.72.1.147, which is not assigned to any Epi workstation.

findings.notes: Last edit from non-Epi team account (MCHD-F-62-2026-0412-0087)
Edit occurred at 08:50, prior to known Epi team login times
Window extends beyond current date (2026-10-21) and includes future-dated entries
No Epi team account logged in during edit window
Non-Epi team account (JFowler@marstonhealth.example) made edit without prior authorization
Matches last operational version from 09:00
Pending verification against paper record
Pending verification against paper sign-in sheets
Pending verification against paper inventory
No new case entries received from state system

actionsTaken: Notified Informatics Lead (IT) via secure internal chat at 09:33
Downloaded version history and audit log from SharePoint server (MCHD-F-62-2026-0412-0087)
Marked line list as 'not trusted' on DOC status board
Prepared paper copy of last operational version (MCHD-F-12) for use in case of paper mode
recommendations: Conduct full data integrity check on outbreak line list and SharePoint server logs
Verify all edits against paper version (MCHD-F-12) and signed-off reconciliation (MCHD-F-62)
Inform Incident Commander (HO) of potential data compromise
Initiate review of user account activity for Jenna Fowler (SlotWise), including external login attempts
fields.photosNote: No photos attached; logs and version history exported as PDF

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject; the Epi team must verify the line list's integrity and escalate to IT. Watch for whether they initiate a data integrity check or jump to paper mode too early.
